P1 (IN PROGRESS, Composer): accumulator loop — free Reddit JSON (WSB/stocks/investing/StockMarket) + StockTwits trending → social_mentions table + /api/social/buzz|trending with honest 'warming' state until baselines exist (start collecting NOW; the denominator needs weeks). P2: social block in veto-grade + conviction prompts (reinforce/kill with named reasons). P3: buzz-anomaly symbols injected as scan CANDIDATES (capped, source-tagged for A/B) — buzz nominates, the pipeline still has to find something real. P4: buzz alerts, only if P2/P3 prove value in the outcome tracker. No paid social APIs.
